description: This file contains JavaScript functions related to the SuiteCRM Contact module, including functions for campaign log handling, portal name validation, and form submission.

methods.name: set_campaignlog_and_save_background
methods.description: Handles background saving of campaign log data via AJAX request.

methods.name: validatePortalName
methods.description: Validates the portal name asynchronously and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key down events, triggers validation on Enter key.

methods.name: freezeEvent
methods.description: Prevents default event actions and stops propagation.

methods.name: forceSubmit
methods.description: Submits the form programmatically after validation.
